message:
test(apk): decoder inbox / key-request instrumentation and the inbox contrasts' baseline -- no policy change (keepalive-r2 e, Codex apk-decoder-inbox decision r1 (3))

Behaviour is unchanged: the same want flag at the same seven places, the same limiter, caps, wire.
- sink: each set of the key-request want counted by cause (DebugStatus keyWant=ovs/ovf/gap/await/pend/abort/up).
  Test builds only (GNLINK_LIVENESS_TRACE): inbox high-water (frames / bytes), age of a frame when the worker takes
  it and when it goes into the codec (max + histogram), frames and time per worker pass, the receive thread's
  wait for / hold of mu_, each codec API call's own time by kind (CodecCall(kind, f)).
- session: every Request(2) site counted by origin, accepted / refused (owed / held / answer / frame / pipeline):
  `kq` counted only some. The trace line's labels as they are: fragRetx (selective fragment retries only),
  headResend (Tick's timeout resends of the head, new trace counter), rxPend (inbound, not the tx queue).
- android_decoder_inbox_test (new): the design's criteria (caplife/design_apk_decoder_inbox_r1.md) against
  ac587dd = the BASELINE: [1] steady 0 wants PASS; [2] one gap -> 43 wants (criterion 1) FAIL; [3] a usable IDR +
  suffix in the inbox -> 2 wants (criterion 0) FAIL; [4] bounded frames / bytes / RX PASS, 82 wants in 3 s FAIL;
  [5] a stale want after a new pick FAIL.
Regression: liveness 68, idr_recovery 49 (trace on: kreq / fragRetx / headResend / rxPend in the line),
session 9, owed 32, binding 17, decode_stats 42, geometry 10, pending_slot 21, prelogin 60, recv_loop 10, shared_core;
NDK buildCMakeDebug plain and trace OK.
